question: With which of the following sports is the English professional club, Chelsea associated?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Football**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Chelsea** is a professional football club based in London, England.
 
• The club was founded in **1905** and has since become one of the most successful teams in English football.
 
• Chelsea competes in the **Premier League**, which is the top tier of English football.
 
• The club has won numerous domestic and international titles, including the **UEFA Champions League** and the **Premier League**.
 
• Chelsea's home ground is **Stamford Bridge**, which is located in Fulham, London.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Roman Abramovich** purchased Chelsea in 2003, leading to a period of significant investment in players and facilities.
 
• The club's colors are royal blue shirts and shorts with white socks.
 
• Chelsea has a fierce rivalry with several clubs, most notably with **Arsenal** and **Tottenham Hotspur**.
 
• The club's nickname is the **"Blues"** due to their blue kit.
 
• Chelsea has a strong global fanbase and is known for its youth academy, which has produced several talented players.
